heroBody: On-site, expert and affordable repairs for your PC, Mac and laptop, anywhere in Brisbane. Open every day from 7 AM to 10 PM, holidays included. No call out fees.
introBody: Servicing Greater Brisbane, including Logan, Ipswich, Moreton and Redland Bay.

services.symptom: It’s full of pop-ups and running slow
services.title: Virus & Malware
services.body: We remove the infection, clean up what it left behind and set up protection before you get it back.
points: Protection set up before you get it back

services.symptom: I can’t get my files back
services.title: Data Recovery
services.body: We recover photos, documents and email from failed or dead drives, wherever the hardware allows it.
points: Backups set up so it doesn’t happen again

services.symptom: The screen’s cracked or it won’t turn on
services.title: Laptop & Mac Hardware
services.body: Smashed screens, blank displays, missing keys and laptops that won’t power on. MacBooks and iMacs included.

services.symptom: I’ve got a new machine to set up
services.title: Setup & Migration
services.body: We set up the new one and move everything across from the old one, so it’s all where you left it.
points: New PC or Mac set up at your place
Files, email and photos moved across

whyUs.title: Open 7 AM to 10 PM
whyUs.body: Every day of the year, holidays included. Weekends and late nights carry no extra surcharge.

whyUs.title: No Fix, No Fee
whyUs.body: No call out fees, no travel fees, no hidden charges. If we cannot fix it, you do not pay.

whyUs.title: Usually Done In An Hour
whyUs.body: Most repairs are finished within the first hour, whether that is in the workshop or at your place.

whyUs.title: As Seen On Channel 9
whyUs.body: We were interviewed by Channel 9 about slow internet speeds around Brisbane.

ctaBody: Tell us what is going wrong and we will come back with a price to fix it.
